cultural_district.designation_date_note: Dataset date uses January 1 within 2017; do not promote this to an exact founding day. Organization describes founding year 2017.

history_stops.name: Compton's Corner (Turk & Taylor)
history_stops.title: Compton's Corner (Turk & Taylor)
history_stops.note: Gene Compton's Cafeteria stood at 101–121 Taylor Street at Turk, where trans women and Tenderloin neighbors resisted police harassment in August 1966 — anchoring the Transgender Cultural District (founded 2017) within the wider Tenderloin.
history_stops.source_note: SF Historic Preservation Commission agenda (2026-03-18): 101–121 Taylor, northwest corner of Turk and Taylor, associated with the 1966 Compton's Cafeteria uprising in the Transgender Cultural District.

history_stops.name: Former Black Hawk Jazz Club (Turk & Hyde)
history_stops.title: Former Black Hawk Jazz Club (Turk & Hyde)
history_stops.note: At 200 Hyde Street at Turk — four blocks west of Mason — the Black Hawk jazz club hosted Miles Davis (April 1961 Friday Night at the Blackhawk), Thelonious Monk, Dave Brubeck, Billie Holiday, and Vince Guaraldi from 1949 to 1963.
history_stops.source_note: SFJAZZ & Miles Davis official catalog (April 1961 Friday Night at the Blackhawk); Tenderloin Museum identifies 200 Hyde at Turk (closed 1963) and 2022 Blackhawk Block Party archive.
